general.title: General
general.subtitle: Manage your profile and account preferences.
general.error_name: Please enter a valid name (minimum 2 characters)
general.error_email: Please enter a valid email address
general.photo_hint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 2 MB. The same photo appears on your other devices.
general.photo_too_large: That image is larger than 2 MB.
general.photo_error: The photo could not be saved. Check that you are signed in to Dome.
general.analytics_description: Help improve Dome by understanding how the app is used. Data is completely anonymous.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.subtitle: Customize how Dome looks.
appearance.dark_notice: Dark mode and system sync will be available soon.
appearance.custom_desc: Coming soon — fonts, density, accent colors
appearance.reset_layout_desc: Restore default sidebar and Many panel widths.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.subtitle: Updates, system preferences and data.
advanced.update_channel_hint: Beta receives new versions before everyone else.
advanced.auto_save_desc: Automatically save your work as you type
advanced.auto_backup_desc: Create backups of your data periodically
advanced.export_import_desc: Move all your data to another device or create a manual backup.
advanced.notes_migration_desc: Migrate old notes to the new domain to enable tree, history and backlinks.

language.title: Language
language.subtitle: Choose your preferred language for the interface.
language.select_desc: The selected language will be applied immediately.

ai.title: AI Settings
ai.subtitle: Configure the conversation provider and models.
ai.context_subtitle: Many and agent-chat read these files on every turn. Inspect and edit them here.
ai.context_unsaved_confirm: You have unsaved changes. Discard them?
ai.context_agent_view_hint: Truncated preview using the same character limits the harness applies at injection time.
ai.context_over_limit: This file exceeds the injection limit (~{{limit}} chars). Current: {{count}}. It will be truncated at runtime.
ai.context_memory_toggle_hint: Disabling memory excludes personal memories from new context and prevents automatic writes on every surface. SOUL, project instructions and conversation history remain available. Manual editing is always available.
ai.models_error: Could not load models. Check your API key and network.
ai.dome_card_hint: Managed cloud — no API key needed
ai.models_configured_only: Only showing models from configured providers.
ai.ollama_install: Make sure Ollama is installed and running.
ai.ollama_local_hint: Local Ollama does not require an API key. Only needed for a remote host (Ollama Cloud).
ai.ollama_cloud_api_key_required: Ollama Cloud requires an API key. Add it below or use http://localhost:11434 for local Ollama.
ai.local_openai_install_lmstudio: Make sure LM Studio is running and the local server is started (Developer → Start server).
ai.local_openai_install_vllm: Make sure a vLLM server is running (vllm serve, default port 8000).
ai.local_openai_api_key_hint: Optional. Only needed if your server requires a Bearer token.
ai.local_openai_unreachable: Could not reach the local server. Check the base URL and that the process is running.
ai.local_openai_no_models_lmstudio: Connected, but no chat models were listed. Load a model in LM Studio and click Refresh.
ai.local_openai_no_models_vllm: Connected, but vLLM listed no chat models. Confirm the served model id and click Refresh.
ai.context_window_hint: Tokens this model can take. Fill this in if the server does not report a length.
ai.openrouter_models_error: Could not load OpenRouter models. Check your API key and network.
ai.ocr_notice: OCR on scanned PDFs: model must support vision. Compatible:
ai.dome_connect_desc: Activates the managed provider with the automatic dome/auto model. Open the dashboard, log in and click "Connect Dome Desktop".
ai.copilot_connect_desc: Sign in with GitHub to use Copilot models. A browser window will open; enter the code shown below.
ai.claude_oauth_connect_desc: Sign in with your Claude subscription. A browser window will open; this uses unofficial OAuth and may break without notice.
ai.claude_oauth_unavailable: Claude subscription login is not available in this build.
ai.openai_codex_connect_desc: Sign in with your ChatGPT Plus/Pro subscription via device code. Unofficial integration — may break without notice.
ai.openai_codex_enter_code: Enter this code on the ChatGPT device page:
ai.openai_codex_unavailable: ChatGPT subscription login is not available in this build.
ai.cloud_sync_desc: Requires an active subscription with the cloud_sync feature. Pushes your library snapshot and pulls changes from other devices (LWW by server revision).
ai.brave_desc: Many and agents search the web via HTTP providers (SearXNG/DDG by default; Tavily/Brave if configured).
ai.brave_search_desc: Configure search and fetch backends for agents. Without API keys, SearXNG + Jina Reader work out of the box.

visible_models.title: Models in selector
visible_models.subtitle: Choose which {{provider}} models appear in model pickers (chat, settings, agents).
visible_models.empty_visible: No models selected — add at least one from the catalog.
visible_models.empty_catalog: All catalog models are already in the selector.
visible_models.add_by_id_hint: For models not listed in the catalog. The ID is added to the selector immediately.
visible_models.row_desc: Choose which models appear when you switch models in chat.

ai.dome_login_network_error: Could not reach the Dome server. Try again.
ai.provider_search_empty: Nothing matches “{{query}}”. Try the company or model name.
ai.test_unavailable: Connection test isn’t available in this version.

domain_sync.title: Domain sync
domain_sync.description: Keeps your whole Dome in sync with Dome Cloud — library, files, conversations, agents, learn, social, pipelines and calendar. Requires an active Dome subscription.
domain_sync.subtitle: Sync your content across devices with your Dome subscription.

plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.subtitle: Manage plugins installed in Dome. Install new ones from the Add-ons.
plugins.empty_desc: Explore the Add-ons to discover plugins
plugins.install_hint: Select a folder containing manifest.json. You can also install from the Add-ons.
plugins.configure_description: Choose the vault and review the access this plugin receives.
plugins.vault_description: The plugin can only access its notes in this vault.
plugins.content_folder_description: Markdown files are committed here after each approval.
plugins.content_paths: Content folders by collection and language
plugins.content_paths_description: Dome uses collection/language to select the folder. The Markdown filename is always the slug.
plugins.site_url_description: Public origin used to open a published entry.
plugins.site_path_pattern_description: /{collection}/{slug} is the same for every language. {/language}/{collection}/{slug} adds /en only outside the first language. /{language}/{collection}/{slug} always includes the language.
plugins.website_vault_description: Entries for this website live in this vault.
plugins.vault_auto_hint: If you do not choose a vault, Dome creates one when you save.
plugins.site_icon_description: Shown next to the website. Dome can read the favicon from the site URL.
plugins.detect_structure_hint: Reads src/content and the repository default language, then fills the folders and the link format.
plugins.detect_structure_empty: No Markdown entries were found in src/content/collection/language.
plugins.detect_structure_truncated: The repository is too large to read in full.
plugins.detect_structure_error: Could not read the repository structure
plugins.favicon_error: Could not read the site icon

mcp.title: MCP
mcp.subtitle: Model Context Protocol — configure MCP servers, discover their tools and define which ones are globally active for Many, agents and teams.
mcp.mcp_enabled_desc: Enable or disable all MCP servers globally
mcp.no_servers: No MCP servers. Add one or import JSON.
mcp.tools_reused: Reused in Many, agents and teams.
mcp.error_no_servers: No valid servers found in JSON
mcp.error_invalid_json: Invalid JSON. Use mcpServers format or array.
mcp.directory_tree_warning: directory_tree is disabled by default — it can freeze the chat on large folders (especially on Windows). Use Dome native file_tree or file_list instead.
mcp.directory_tree_tool_desc: Recursive tree without limits. Enable only for small folders; prefer native file_tree.

skills.title: Skills
skills.subtitle: Skills are prompt-driven specializations that Many can use when relevant. Add instructions for specific domains (SQL, legal review, formats…).
skills.subtitle_file: Skills live as SKILL.md files (Claude-style): ~/.dome/skills (personal) and .dome/skills in an optional project root. Edit the YAML frontmatter and body, or use Import/Export JSON.
skills.project_root_help: Set an optional Git/workspace folder; Dome will load .dome/skills next to that project (lower priority than ~/.dome/skills).
skills.edit_help: Full SKILL.md file (YAML frontmatter + Markdown). Save writes to disk; changes apply on the next message.
skills.create_failed: Could not create skill (folder may already exist).
skills.empty: No skills. Add one or import from JSON.
skills.description_placeholder: E.g.: SQL expert. Use when the user needs queries or data analysis.
skills.error_invalid_json: Invalid JSON. Use an array of objects with id, name, description, prompt.
skills.error_no_skills: No valid skills found in the JSON
skills.github_hint: Enter a GitHub repo URL and optional skill name (e.g. pptx). Equivalent to: npx skills add <repo> --skill <name>
skills.no_skills_found: No skills found in that repository.

cloud.title: Cloud Storage
cloud.subtitle: Connect Google Drive to explore and import files directly in Dome.

memory.subtitle: Review personal memories, domain context and recent logs.
memory.policy_hint: Disabling memory excludes personal memories from new context and prevents automatic writes on every surface. SOUL, project instructions and conversation history remain available. Manual editing is always available.
